AEG Apple Pie

Double-crust apple pie for the confirmed AEG BE3002420M oven.

8 slices3 h 05 minMedium1 cook

1AssumptionsWhat I decided for you — override anything here

  • One round pieAssumes a 20-22 cm pie dish. For slab pie, use the two-tray card instead.
  • One cookThe timeline has one person lane; fridge and oven work unattended.
  • AEG has dial functionsBE3002420M has no numbered programs. Select Conventional Cooking, the two-bar symbol.
  • Manual apple-pie bakeManual table supports shelf 1, 180 C, 70-90 min. Use a darker cue than time alone.
  • Firm tart applesSoft sweet apples collapse faster. Reduce sugar to 80 g if apples are very sweet.

Ingredients

3Steps

  1. 1

    Cube cold butterCook

    Worktop8 minkeep cold

    Flour, butter, sugar, salt

    Cube butter, weigh dry ingredients, keep everything cold until mixing.

    Butter is cold cubes.

  2. 2

    Mix shortcrustCook

    Kenwood KWL90.244SIK-beaterspeed 1-210-12 min

    Dry mix, butter, egg, sour cream

    Mix dry, add butter to sandy, add egg and cream, stop immediately at clumps.

    Dough clumps when squeezed.

  3. 3

    Chill doughCook

    RefrigeratorCovered dough30 minlarger base

    Two dough disks, cover

    Divide into larger base disk and smaller top disk, cover, chill.

    Dough rolls without smearing.

  4. 4

    Slice applesCook

    Adam apple slicer12-wedge cutter12 wedges3-5 mm20 min

    Apples, sugar, lemon, cinnamon, starch

    Core apples with slicer, knife-slice wedges thin, toss with sugar, lemon, cinnamon, and starch.

    Slices are evenly coated.

  5. 5

    Preheat ovenCook

    AEG Competence BE3002420MWire shelftwo-bar symbol180 C15 minshelf 1

    Oven, wire shelf

    Set Conventional Cooking, temperature 180 C, and place wire shelf on shelf position 1.

    Oven is fully preheated.

  6. 6

    Assemble pieCook

    Worktop15-20 minseal vents

    Dough, filling, breadcrumbs, egg wash

    Roll base, add crumbs and apples, cover with top crust, seal, vent, brush egg wash.

    Top is sealed and vented.

  7. 7

    Bake pieCook

    AEG Competence BE3002420MWire shelfConventional180 C70-90 minshelf 1

    Assembled pie

    Bake on shelf 1. Shield rim with foil only if browning before juices bubble.

    Juices bubble through vents.

  8. 8

    Cool before slicingCook

    Worktop30 minset juices

    Baked pie, knife, server

    Cool on a heatproof surface before cutting; wait 60 minutes for cleaner slices.

    Filling holds in slices.

  • Wash hands and brush after raw egg.
  • Refrigerate leftovers after same-day serving.
  • Reheat slices until hot throughout.
